title: session.save
description: Writes the session's snapshot to sessions/default.json in the state directory (ADR-0034): the layout and, per pane, its OSC 7 directory or else its shell's own (ADR-0040) and the program it started, redacted. No scrollback and no environment. The directory is 0700, the file 0600, written to a temporary file and renamed. Needs hello version 2 and a caller in a terminal outside every pane.
